verdict.rationale: An in-product AI insight feature is a fair question for a Git hosting platform, so the axis applies. However, the evidence shows no built-in AI-generated insights or suggestions. The official MCP server lets external agents connect to Gitea, which is a building block rather than an in-product capability. Repository Activity and Code Frequency are non-AI statistics, an adjacent feature that earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
